newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 early rice output up 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 early rice output up 4.2 pct.

text.p: China's 1996 early rice crop was 44 million tonnes, up 1.79 million tonnes or 4.2 percent over last year, the State Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
It said that the major areas of growth were in Jiangxi, Guangdong and Zhejiang provinces.
The output figure is based on a survey of producing areas, according to the official Xinhua news agency.

The agency quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying that a key reason for the upturn was an increase in acreage planted. It said the total area under early rice cultivation was 8.29 million hectares, up 90,000 hectares, or 1.1 percent.
It also said that technical improvements had allowed crop yield to rise by 3.1 percent and favourable weather conditions also were a contributing factor.
State purchases of early rice reached 9.08 million tonnes by the end of August, above the target of 7.96 million tonnes set by the state, the news agency said.
